record.label: Near-floor tail stability and population validation
record.summary: The exact late-layer defect and its one-line trigger repair are solved, the source/meter/package are frozen, and the repaired candidate is board-validated. The complete 688-row observer_fit scan finds exactly 11 base trajectories above the registered >5e-7 rule; all 11 frozen-source repairs are finite and fall below the same threshold. This closes the measured public-analog tail family without asserting private-board identity matches.
record.terminal_criterion: Solved by completing all 688 observer_fit base trajectories and returning every registered >5e-7 tail to a finite below-threshold trajectory with the frozen near-floor-min source.
